compute_toa_solar_radiation: compute top-of-atmosphere solar radiation for given timestamps, latitudes, and longitudes using get_toa_incident_solar_radiation
compute_toa_solar_radiation_xarray: compute top-of-atmosphere solar radiation from an xarray Dataset or DataArray using get_toa_incident_solar_radiation_for_xarray
get_tsi_values: get interpolated Total Solar Irradiance values for a sequence of timestamps using get_tsi
get_era5_tsi_data: get ERA5-compatible yearly Total Solar Irradiance data as an xarray DataArray using era5_tsi_data
get_reference_tsi_data: get a single reference Total Solar Irradiance value of 1361 W/m² as an xarray DataArray using reference_tsi_data
